description:
Your Nashville adventure starts here! This modern condo offers a prime location near the city's top attractions. With comfortable accommodations, including a king bed and sofa bed, this apartment is ideal for all. Enjoy the convenience of a full kitchen, free parking, and Wi-Fi. Explore downtown, Broadway, and more, all within easy reach, making it the perfect base for your Nashville experience.

The space
Who is this property GREAT for?

*  Coffee and tea enthusiasts 
*  Couples who enjoy a very comfortable king bed
*  Concert and live event goers
*  Traveling for work with dedicated workspace and high speed Wi-Fi 
*  Traveling for a wedding 
*  Looking to be a short drive from all Nashville attractions 
*  Musicians
*  Foodies

Who is this property NOT for?

*  Guests younger than 25
*  Groups looking to throw a party 
*  Inside smokers of any kind 
*  Groups of more than 4

Guest access
You will receive an access code the day of check in.

Other things to note
This property is on the second floor. It offers stairs, as well as side entry with a loading ramp with no stairs at all.
